caption: Before install Compass asks for customer data including sensitive data, staff data and edit rights on customers, orders and analytics. Store and organization names are hidden.
There is no free plan: the welcome screen only offers Choose your plan, and the 14 day trial starts after you subscribe. The store name is hidden.
$49 a month or $490 a year ($41 a month), with the same six features on both; one trial per shop. The store name is hidden.
Approving Compass Monthly needed a payment method first, so Approve stayed grey and we never reached the app itself. The store name is hidden.
The FAQ says you cancel in Compass under Pricing or Settings, or through the Shopify admin under Apps. The store name is hidden.
Uninstalling asks for a reason and sends the developer a request to delete customer data within 48 hours. Store and organization names are hidden.
